# UI UX Pro Max Skill — vendored agent skills

Source: https://github.com/nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max-skill
Upstream commit: `7f69fed6a2717900085f1bc3b263721f8ba025e2`
License: MIT (see `LICENSE` in this directory)

Installed project-locally for IKIGAI Sport using the upstream CLI built from the source repository above.

- Claude Code skills: `.claude/skills/`
- Universal Agent Skills: `.agents/skills/`

The installed skill set includes `ui-ux-pro-max` and its sibling skills (`banner-design`, `brand`, `design-system`, `design`, `slides`, and `ui-styling`).
